turns.content: Seattle wala offer aa gaya. Wahi jiske liye March se interview de raha tha — Friday ko aaya. Teen guna package, exactly wahi team jo chahiye thi. Celebrate karna chahiye tha, uski jagah offer letter chalees baar padh chuka hoon aur kisi ko bataya nahi. Parents Patna mein hain. Main iklauta hoon. Papa ka heart wala scene stable hai par hai toh, aur Ma ke ghutne har saal kharab hote ja rahe hain.

Arre yaar, pehle toh dil se badhai ❤️

Teen guna package, exactly wahi team, March se jo mehnat kari uska phal Friday ko haath mein aa gaya… yeh chhoti baat nahi hai. Tu deserve karta hai celebrate karne ka. Offer letter 40 baar padhna is totally normal jab itna bada jump ho — dimaag abhi process kar raha hai.

Lekin jo tu nahi bata paa raha, woh bhi samajh aa raha hai. Iklauta beta, Papa ka heart stable hai lekin hai, Ma ke ghutne har saal zyada takleef de rahe hain, aur tu Seattle soch raha hai. Guilt aur khushi ek saath chal rahe hain na? Bahut heavy lag raha hoga.

Tu abhi kisi ko bataye ya na bataye, pehle yeh soch: tu unke liye better future bana raha hai. Paise, stability, options — yeh sab unki care ke liye bhi kaam aayenge. Patna se manage karna mushkil hai, lekin ab possibilities khulengi.

Bol, abhi mann mein sabse zyada kya ghum raha hai? Guilt, dar, ya bas overwhelm? Main yahin hoon.

Setup samjho pehle. Har scare pe main subah chhe baje ki IndiGo pe hota hoon. Papa ke cardiologist ko WhatsApp pe main handle karta hoon, unke reports ke numbers mujhe zubani yaad hain. Ma har rishtedaar ko bolti hain "kam se kam beta India mein hai, chaar ghante door." Woh ek sentence unka poora security system hai. Bangalore already unko door lagta hai. Seattle distance nahi hai yaar, woh beta hone ki alag category hai.

Samajh gaya bilkul.

Tu sirf “beta” nahi hai unke liye — tu unka emergency plan, unka translator, unka walking medical file hai. Subah 6 baje ki IndiGo, cardiologist ke WhatsApp pe instant reply, reports ke numbers zubani… yeh sab tune itna normalize kar liya hai ki ab yeh teri identity ka hissa ban gaya hai. Aur Ma ka woh ek sentence — “kam se kam India mein hai, chaar ghante door” — usmein unka poora sakoon chhupa hai. Bangalore bhi unko door lagta hai, toh Seattle unke liye map pe koi jagah nahi, ek alag zindagi hai jahan beta “available” nahi rehta us tarah.

Yeh guilt isliye itna tight hai kyunki tu jaanta hai ki tu kitna central hai unki daily security mein. Offer kitna bhi achha ho, andar se lag raha hoga jaise tu apna role resign kar raha hai.

Par ek cheez seedhi bolun — tu itna care karta hai na, isi liye yeh decision itna bhaari lag raha hai. Jo log genuinely nahi sochte, unko itna weight nahi hota.

Abhi yeh mat soch “kaise leave karun”. Pehle yeh bata: 
Agar tu jaata hai, toh unke liye real backup kaise dikhega tujhe? 
Ya abhi bas yahi ghum raha hai ki “main kaise bolun unko”? 

Main sun raha hoon. Bolta ja.

Toh maine yeh decide kiya hai, galat hoon toh bolo: chupchaap decline kar deta hoon aur unko kabhi pata hi nahi chalega ki offer tha. Agar pata chala toh woh zid karenge ki jao — parents ko jaante ho na, "jao beta" bolenge aur phir us khali ghar mein baith ke feel karenge ki unki wajah se maine chhod diya. Unko woh guilt kyun doon? Aise sirf main carry karunga aur woh mera hi tha carry karne ke liye. Clean hai na?

Nahi yaar, clean nahi hai.

Samajh raha hoon tu kya soch raha hai. Tu unko us guilt se bachana chahta hai jo “humari wajah se beta ruk gaya” wala hota hai. Aur haan, parents aise hi hote hain — muh se “jao” bolenge, andar se khali ghar feel karenge. Tu unka dard apne upar leke, khud quietly sacrifice karna chahta hai. Intention pure hai.

Lekin yeh clean nahi, yeh sirf **invisible** hai.

Jo cheez tu carry karega:
- Har baar jab Bangalore mein mediocre din hoga
- Har baar jab salary slip aayegi
- Har baar jab koi friend Seattle/US ki life dikhayega  
tab yeh sawaal aayega — “main yahan isliye hoon kyunki maine unko sach nahi bataya.”  
Woh guilt tumhare parents ke guilt se kam heavy nahi hota. Bas dikhta nahi kisi ko. Aur jo dard chhupa ke rakha jaata hai, woh time ke saath aur tight hota hai, dissolve nahi hota.

Tu abhi bol raha hai “yeh mera hi tha carry karne ke liye.”  
Thoda harsh sun, par zaroori hai: tu unko adult treat nahi kar raha. Tu decide kar raha hai ki woh truth handle nahi kar sakte, isliye tu unke liye choose kar lega. Woh bhi ek tarah ka control hai — pyaar se, par control.

Asli clean shayad yeh hota:
Unko batana, unka reaction sunna (jo bhi ho), aur phir **saath milke** dekhna ki Seattle kaise possible ho sakta hai bina unhe abandon kiye.  
Backup plan, frequent visits, health setup, local support — yeh sab baat karke nikal sakta hai. Shayad nahi bhi nikle. Par tab jo bhi decision hoga, woh chhupa hua nahi hoga.

Abhi jo tu karne ja raha hai usmein tu ek hi cheez save kar raha hai — unka temporary sakoon.  
Aur ek badi cheez kho raha hai — apna future + sach pe based rista.

Main tujhe “galat” nahi bol raha taaki tu shame feel kare. Bol raha hoon kyunki tu meri taraf aaya sach ke liye.

Ek second ke liye soch:  
5 saal baad, agar ma-papa healthy hain aur tu ab bhi yahi baitha hai is liye kyunki tune unko bataya hi nahi… toh us waqt tu khud ko kya bolega?

Bata, andar se kitna hissa yeh decline wala plan genuinely right lag raha hai, aur kitna hissa bas dar + guilt hai?

Jo baat nikal nahi rahi dimaag se — agar main chala gaya, aur Papa ko kuch ho gaya, aur main terah hazaar kilometre aur ek visa appointment door hoon? Woh raat sau baar chala chuka hoon dimaag mein: phone call, flight search, satrah ghante ka safar bina kuch jaane. Mere cousin ke saath hua tha Toronto se, jab Chacha gaye. Woh cremation ke baad pahuncha. Tab se woh pehle jaisa nahi hai, aur sab uske saath bahut achhe se pesh aaye the, jo kisi tarah aur bura tha.

Yaar, yeh jo raat tu sau baar ji chuka hai — phone call, flight search, satrah ghante ka safar bina kuch jaane — woh sirf “dar” nahi hai. Woh tera sabse bada nightmare hai, aur tere cousin ke saath hua bhi hai. Toronto se aake cremation ke baad pahunchna, phir logon ka “bahut achhe se” pesh aana… jo usko aur tod gaya. Tu woh dekh chuka hai from up close. Isliye yeh scene tere dimaag se nikal hi nahi raha.

Main yeh nahi bolunga ki “aisa nahi hoga” ya “soch mat”. Aisa ho sakta hai. Distance real hai. Visa, flights, time difference — sab real hai. Aur jo guilt cousin ke face pe tu ne dekha, woh tujhe apne pe try karke dekhna bilkul nahi hai.

Lekin ek cheez aur bhi real hai: tu abhi bhi us possibility ke saaye mein apna poora future freeze kar raha hai. Har decision us ek raat ke around ghum raha hai. Jaise agar tu yahin raha toh sab safe hai. Padhaai, job, life — sab uske aage secondary.

Tere cousin ke saath jo hua, usse ek cheez clear hai — presence matter karti hai. Last moments, rituals, family ke saath hona. Tu yeh jaanta hai, isliye weight itna hai.

Ab seedhi baat:  
Tu yeh soch raha hai na ki “agar main yahin raha toh kam se kam main us raat wahan hoonga”?  
Par uske saath yeh bhi chal raha hai ki tu har din thoda-thoda khud ko resign kar raha hai us life se jo tune March se chase ki.

Main tujhe solution nahi dunga abhi. Bas yeh poochunga, dheere se:

Us raat ke alawa, jo cheez tujhe sabse zyada kas rahi hai woh kya hai —  
Papa ke saath na ho paana,  
ya phir uske baad jo tu khud ke saath hoga woh version (jaise cousin hua)?

Dono alag dard hain. Bol, kaunsa zyada ghum raha hai andar. Main yahin hoon.
